summary: The hostile monster-player chat path in sounds.c:domonnoise reaches mplayer.c:mplayer_talk in C, but js/sounds.js records note_unported and omits the class-specific quote and its rn2(3) draw. Port the entire mplayer_talk function in js/mplayer.js and replace that caller placeholder.

source.branch: During #chat in the Endgame, an audible hostile monster-player with MS_HUMANOID reaches domonnoise; mplayer_talk returns immediately for peaceful monsters and otherwise chooses a same-class or other-class quote with rn2(3).
callers: sounds.c:domonnoise at 1025-1030 calls mplayer_talk for hostile endgame monster-players; js/sounds.js:domonnoise contains the matching note_unported branch.
The production entry is #chat through sounds.c:dochat and js/sounds.js:dochat, dispatched by the command registry.
dependencies: rng.c:rn2 supplies the single quote-selection draw for nonpeaceful monsters.
pline.c:verbalize emits the quoted line and owns PLINE_VERBALIZE state.
sndprocs.h:276 defines SetVoice as empty in the recorder build, so it has no runtime output/state effect here.

evidence: The saved v52 queue identifies challenges/manifests/v52.json with canonical manifest SHA-256 38c5e274ac970a16df08fb372269edc360f8c61f507020f29f71d9335ea9f29e, recording SHA-256 8838b6872e3c628f3783834a5a2198f56f0ff4895940c59abd1de9df20a0bb9c, and hosted evaluation challenges/evaluations/hosted-38292091033-1-v52.json at fcfb7afe71226851b75665b753b0c2c73ceb7af4.

The first mismatch is segment 0 step 104, input key u: C logs rn2(3)=1 from mplayer_talk(mplayer.c:376), while JS logs rn2(12)=4 after the caller records note_unported and omits the quote-selection draw. Baseline metrics are 114/115 screens and cursors, with 4721/4726 RNG calls matching.

nethack-c/upstream/src/mplayer.c:356-375 is the complete mplayer_talk function. It returns for peaceful monsters, calls SetVoice (a no-op under sndprocs.h:276 in this recorder build), selects one of three messages according to whether mtmp->data is the hero role species, and calls verbalize with the selected line.

nethack-c/upstream/src/sounds.c:1025-1030 is the production caller branch in domonnoise; it runs only for a hostile MS_HUMANOID monster-player on an endgame level. js/sounds.js:1243-1248 currently records the missing callee. The task will replace only this branch and does not claim whole domonnoise completion.
js/sounds.js:dochat reaches domonnoise after the player selects an adjacent monster via #chat. The complete function scope is mplayer.c:mplayer_talk plus this bounded caller replacement.
